title: Which Backend Decides? False Positives of Reference-Existence Screens on Legitimate Computer-Science Bibliographies: code and derived data
description: Code, pre-registration (with Amendments 1-5) and derived data for a study of how often reference-existence screens flag legitimate references on 1,298 arXiv computer-science papers. The offline reproduction script reruns every reported number from three derived reference-level files and compares it with the committed results.
